 · 23 October 2026 
 Official statement 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Santos FC would like to clarify that, due to construction work in the Ground-Level Stands, 437 seats will be closed for this Saturday’s match against Bahia.
 As a result, Vila Belmiro’s total capacity will be 16,590 people.
 OneFootball Videos
 The Club apologizes for the inconvenience but emphasizes that the work is part of Vila Belmiro’s modernization (retrofit) project. Once completed, we will be able to accommodate more Santos fans in greater comfort and safety.
